name: Jacuzzi
desc:
Bilingual Customer Care Representative | $19.00/hr | Phone Heavy
1. Company: Jacuzzi Bath Remodel (Jacuzzi Group)
Industry: Home Improvement / Bath Remodeling, Customer Service
What Your Day Will Look Like: You'd be the main point of contact for customers after they've signed a contract for a bath remodel, making sure everything's set up right before the installers ever show up. That means reviewing sales contracts to confirm the correct product and measurements were included, flagging any pricing or measurement discrepancies back to the sales team, and calling new customers to walk through what they ordered and schedule a tentative installation date. You'd also help schedule service or repair work, provide updates throughout the process, and handle change orders in the company's ERP system. It's a genuine blend of customer care and behind-the-scenes contract accuracy work.
skills:
Actual Minimum Requirements
Education Minimum: Not stated in posting.
Required Experience: Customer service and data entry experience required.
Preferred Experience: Construction or sales contract reviewing experience is preferred, not required.
Required Skills:
Fluency in both English and Spanish, required
High attention to detail
Basic computer knowledge, comfortable operating in ERP systems
Excellent time management with a proven ability to meet deadlines
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
4. Best Fit
 This role is ideal for:
A bilingual English/Spanish speaker, since this is required, not preferred
Someone detail-oriented enough to catch contract or measurement discrepancies before they become a bigger problem
Someone who genuinely enjoys guiding customers through a process, from the initial order through installation and beyond
Someone comfortable working within PST hours, even if based elsewhere
Not a Good Fit for:
Anyone who isn't fluently bilingual in English and Spanish, since this is a hard requirement
Anyone who can't work the 10:00 AM to 6:30 PM PST shift, which runs later into the evening for Central time participants
Anyone unwilling to work an occasional Saturday once a month
Top 10 Resume Keywords:
Bilingual customer service (English/Spanish)
Sales contract review and accuracy
ERP system proficiency
Customer scheduling and follow-up
Data entry accuracy
Problem-solving and discrepancy resolution
Time management under deadline pressure
Construction or home improvement industry
Customer satisfaction and retention
Cross-team communication
notes:
Expected Application & Interviewing Process: 1. Application 2. Expect an assessment at the end of the application or directly emailed to you. 3. If assessment is passing, expect a recruiter to reach out via email or text for a phone screen. 4. If phone screen passes you can expect the final interview. Total time to hire from date of application can be anywhere from 3-15 days on average.
4-5 interview questions for this role:
Tell us about your bilingual customer service experience, in both English and Spanish.
How do you catch a discrepancy or error in a contract before it becomes a bigger issue?
Walk us through how you'd handle an introductory call with a new customer about their upcoming installation.
What's your comfort level working within an ERP system to process change orders?
How do you stay organized managing scheduling and follow-up for multiple customers at once?
other:
Pay, Shift, Benefits, Background, Drug Test Information, and Career Pathway:
Pay: $19.00/hr, confirmed in posting, with opportunities for advancement.
Shift: Monday through Friday, 10:00 AM to 6:30 PM PST (12:00 PM to 8:30 PM CST), with potential for one Saturday per month.
Benefits: Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance plans, paid vacation and holidays, paid training, 401(k) with matching program, and advancement opportunities.
Equipment Provided: Not stated in posting.
Felony Friendly?: Not stated.
Drug Test: Not stated.
Notes: The bilingual requirement is firm and stated outright, not a preference, so this role should only go to genuinely fluent English/Spanish speakers. The PST shift runs notably late for a Central time participant (until 8:30 PM CST), worth confirming comfort with that before referring someone.
Career Pathway: Not stated directly in posting, though advancement opportunities are explicitly mentioned. Reasonable inferred path: Customer Care Representative → Senior Customer Care Representative → Customer Care Team Lead → Customer Care Manager, though this is an estimate, not confirmed by Jacuzzi directly.
